text:
marta: quick heads-up  PartnerHelix marketplace listing tomorrow needs coordinated hero + blog + SI link at publish.

owen: press embargo 09:00 PT. partner requires hero and badge live exactly at publish.

priya: ops note: staging-2 has a third-party infra deploy at 09:00 PT. potential slot collision.

liam: workaround: pre-stage hero behind feature flag and flip at embargo lift. avoids deploy-time slot contention.

opsbot: feature-flag available. ops needs S3 path, UTM strings, final promo code, and preview window.

partner-uploader: uploaded assets to s3://marketplace/partnerhelix/hero-v2 (08:10 PT). preview link: https://staging-2.redwood.ai/partnerhelix/preview

priya: preview looks good; mobile crop minor tweak noted, partner will push by 08:30 PT.

marta: marketing: final UTM=utm_source=partnerhelix&utm_campaign=marketplace_q2 promo=HELIX10. I'll hold the blog PR until flip.

legalbot: legal-approved crediting line: "Partner content provided by PartnerHelix." will post in meta by 08:50 PT. Do not flip before legal OK.

liam: ops timeline proposal:
- 08:30 PT: final assets in place
- 08:45 PT: ops preview (staging-2, flag preview)
- 08:50 PT: legal copy added to meta
- 09:00 PT: embargo lift -> flip flag -> publish blog
- 09:08 PT: CDN purge (avoid 09:00 infra window)
- 09:15 PT: SI smoke test (tokened health check)

priya: SI note  whitelist egress and run: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://si.partnerhelix.com/health | jq -r .status` expecting "ok".

marta: owners assigned: assets=partner-uploader, ops=liam+priya, press=marta, legal=legalbot. ops will be in #release-war-room for preview and flip.

opsbot: reminders set: preview 08:45 PT, flip 09:00 PT, post-launch checks at +8m and +20m. rollback window 3m.

partner-uploader: partner pushed a tiny crop fix at 08:25 PT. new preview link updated.

liam: ops validated preview. standing by for legal signoff then we flip on embargo.

marta: will confirm blog PR merge at 08:55 PT and call flip at 09:00 PT. otherwise move to 09:30 PT.

priya: closing loop: keep updates short in this thread. we'll escalate blockers in #release-war-room only.
